verdict.rationale: OpenRouter documents API compatibility via the OpenAI SDK as a drop-in replacement and provides an OpenAPI spec plus a code-generating Request Builder, but the evidence pack shows no dedicated first-party OpenRouter SDK (e.g., official Python/TS client library) — only compatibility with a third-party SDK. missing for 10: dedicated official OpenRouter SDK packages, language-specific SDK docs/repos, independent developer confirmation of SDK usage beyond OpenAI-compatible client.
